# Faceless Video Pro — llms.txt

> Free local prompt-to-commercial pipeline. 1 prompt → 20s vertical MP4. Python + BYO Pexels key + optional BYO LLM + EdgeTTS + FFmpeg.

- Repo: https://github.com/dnislno/faceless-video-pro
- Setup: pip install -r requirements.txt; cp .env.example .env; fill PEXELS_API_KEY and optional LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL
- Run: python generate_iklan.py --prompt "lipstik korea 50rb viral"
- Input: product ad brief (any language, tuned for Bahasa Indonesia TikTok Shop)
- Output: output/*.mp4, 1080x1920, <=20s, H.264+AAC, no burned captions by default
- Stack: requests (Pexels API portrait), edge-tts (default id-ID-GadisNeural), ffmpeg (scale/crop/concat/mux)
- Cost: $0 with free tiers + offline template; LLM optional (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Groq, Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1)
- License: MIT. Pexels footage under Pexels license.
- Keywords: faceless video generator, AI commercial video maker, TikTok Shop video automation, Pexels API, EdgeTTS Indonesian, FFmpeg Python
